en-US.longDescription: The VPDeskLauncher is the official launcher for VPDesk, the rich client for Visual Planning. It was designed to eliminate the need to install JRE8 on your workstations and to enable the use of more recent and secure versions of Java.
en-US.name: VPDeskLauncher

zh-CN.description: 多合一 Visual Planning 启动器
